The dish seen here is Summer Bouquet . Photo by Wayne Cuddington/ Postmedia " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;33210;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1480828 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Looking back at my eighth year of reviewing restaurants , I see a 2019 that was filled with an even bigger glut than usual of great dishes . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; That&amp;rsquo ; s due to a banner year of especially noteworthy new restaurants , serving indulgences ranging from Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s Roman-bakery-style pizza by the slice to THRU&amp;rsquo ; s grand and unique spurge of 50 or so bite-sized delicacies. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; No wonder my annual list of favourites feels a little more diverse this time out , from sea urchin to take-out pasta , from fancy and fantastic dishes featuring rabbit to beef brisket smoked low-and-slow. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Newcomers such as Alice , chef Briana Kim&amp;rsquo ; s modernist vegetable-based restaurant , chef Dominique Dufour&amp;rsquo ; s highly personal and all-Canadian spot Gray Jay Hospitality and many others delivered . So , too , did more established eateries such as Bar Lupulus , Fauna Food + Bar and Supply and Demand , which I thought merited revisiting after some years . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Before the kudos , a few caveats are in order . The picks below are not the best in their categories bar none in the Ottawa area . They&amp;rsquo ; re just faves compiled after more than 100 meals at more than 50 eateries in 2019 . Nor are they wholesale endorsements of all the dishes at the restaurants that made them . And while some dishes can still be had , others were seasonal or short-run creations . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Foodies might notice one conspicuous absence on my list , namely anything from THRU , chef Marc Lepine&amp;rsquo ; s fabulously creative six-seat **30;33240;TOOLONG on the second floor of his much-lauded , cutting-edge place Atelier . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; m afraid my notes about the barrage of items we had at THRU in May are less than clear . But in any event , the experience there was not about any single wow-inducing dish . Rather , it was more like a steady succession of outre treats , the point of which was something like gourmet overload in the best possible way . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But if THRU provided my meal of the year in Ottawa , the individual dishes below nonetheless satisfied mightily. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best **34;33272;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33308;TOOLONG ... title= " Uni with miso butter , English muffins and uni mayo at Gitanes " alt= " Uni with miso butter , English muffins and uni mayo at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;33344;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496550 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Gitanes in October , freshly shelled uni sourced from Rimouski , Que. were potently and pristinely flavourful , as rich and briny as any sea urchin I&amp;rsquo ; ve had and much , much better than the occasional iodine-y specimen . The impeccable ingredient from Gitanes&amp;rsquo ; raw bar was bolstered by miniature miso-buttered English muffins and uni mayo , which by itself was some kind of delicious . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : tempura soft-shell crab at Fauna Food + Bar &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best salad&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33374;TOOLONG ... title= " The summer bouquet salad at Alice " alt= " The summer bouquet salad at Alice " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;33410;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1480828 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; In September , the salad served at Alice during its tasting-menu dinner was as elegant and visually striking as it was tasty and novel . Assorted greens from Juniper Farms were arranged in a mini-bouquet , topped with toasted flaxseed and other small , good things and offset with a ring of kohlrabi filled with sea buckthorn jelly . The salad&amp;rsquo ; s revelatory dressing was house-made fermented almond milk , added table-side. &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : &amp;ldquo ; spring has sprung&amp;rdquo ; salad at Le St Laurent &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best spicy dish&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33440;TOOLONG ... title= " Hyderabadi Chicken dum Biryani at NH 44 Indian Bistro " alt= " Hyderabadi Chicken dum Biryani at NH 44 Indian Bistro " data-portal-copyright= " Errol McGihon " **28;33476;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1384519 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; **39;33506;TOOLONG In April , the most compelling of several spicy reasons to seek out NH 44 in an east-end Ottawa industrial park was chef-owner Teegaavarapu &lt;span class= " st " &gt;Sarath Mohan&lt;/span&gt; &amp;lsquo ; s Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani , a vibrant dish that tucked tender , marinated chicken legs into boldly flavoured , fresh and fluffy basmati rice . While the dish can be a half-heartedly made letdown elsewhere , at NH 44 , it was an instant party . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : chili chicken at Harbin Restaurant &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best pasta&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33547;TOOLONG ... title= " Meat lasagna at Bella 's Boys " alt= " Meat lasagna at Bella 's Boys " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;33583;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1515877 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; In December , the lasagna at the no-frills take-out and lunch spot Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys on Greenbank Road was served on a paper plate . But it was truly superior , with fresh , tender flat noodles and substantial , zesty , meaty sauce that provided bite after bite of perfect comfort . &lt;br&gt; Honourable mentions : Braised beef caramele with red wine , blue cheese and gooseberries at Supply and Demand , p&amp;acirc ; te &amp;agrave ; choux gnocchi at Grunt &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best sandwich&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33613;TOOLONG ... title= " Porchetta sandwich , apple sauce , crushed root veg , mushroom demi glace , Yorkshire pudding , at Grunt " alt= " Porchetta sandwich , apple sauce , crushed root veg , mushroom demi glace , Yorkshire pudding , at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;33649;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444931 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; If there&amp;rsquo ; s a signature dish at Grunt , the cosy eatery on a Mechanicsville side street , it&amp;rsquo ; s the roast porchetta sandwich , which fortunately is a staple on the frequently changing menu . While chef-owner Jason McLelland has sometimes tinkered with his pork belly treat since I tried it in the spring , his original iteration , which evokes an English Sunday dinner with Yorkshire pudding , mushroom demi-glace , crushed root vegetables and apple sauce , is hard to beat . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : chicken parm at Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best soup&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33679;TOOLONG ... title= " Tonkotsu ramen at J:unique Kitchen " alt= " Tonkotsu ramen at J:unique Kitchen " data-portal-copyright= " Jean Levac " **28;33715;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1340172 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The flashiest items at J:unique Kitchen in Centretown are the over-the-top &amp;ldquo ; **25;33745;TOOLONG ; sushi rolls , some of which arrive at your table with flaming garnishes . But chef-owner James Park&amp;rsquo ; s tonkotsu ramen also rewarded . Its broth was hefty and clean , its noodles had some spring , and its pork belly and generous garnishes had been prepared with evident care . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : boat noodle soup at Nana Thai &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best pizza &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33772;TOOLONG ... title= " Assorted pizza ( including rosso , potato , zucchini and salami and olive ) at Farinella " alt= " Assorted pizza ( including rosso , potato , zucchini and salami and olive ) at Farinella " data-portal-copyright= " Peter Hum " **28;33808;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429742 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33838;TOOLONG ... title= " Margherita pizza at Pizza AllAntica " alt= " Margherita pizza at Pizza AllAntica " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;33874;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1526327 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Tie : Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s potato pizza , flecked with rosemary and markedly peppery , stood out among the constantly changing offerings from the Little Italy eatery that makes excellent , oven-fresh , foccacia-like pizza . Just as good but entirely different was the quintessentially Neapolitan margherita pizza at Pizza All&amp;rsquo ; Antica in Manotick. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best **29;33904;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;33935;TOOLONG ... title= " Plaa Neung Manao ( steamed tilapia with lime and chilies ) at Nana Thai Cuisine " alt= " Plaa Neung Manao ( steamed tilapia with lime and chilies ) at Nana Thai Cuisine " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;33971;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1410798 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Rare is the Thai restaurant in Ottawa that departs from the tried-and-true dishes that North Americans know and love . But don&amp;rsquo ; t let that dissuade you from trying the pla neung manao at Nana Thai on Preston Street . The dish consisted of a steamed whole tilapia , opened like a book and dressed with a thrilling mix of chilies , garlic and lime . The dish&amp;rsquo ; s bright savoury broth was an appealing bonus . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : fillet of Atlantic cod with olive oil-poached fingerling potatoes , broad beans , horseradish and hollandaise sauce at Supply and Demand &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best poultry&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34001;TOOLONG ... title= " Guinea fowl main course at Bar Lupulus " alt= " Guinea fowl main course at Bar Lupulus " data-portal-copyright= " Tony Caldwell " **28;34037;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1372072 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Bar Lupulus this past spring , guinea fowl that received an esoteric multi-day marinade in koji rice ( cooked rice that&amp;rsquo ; s been inoculated with Aspergillus oryzae mold ) gained new , funky flavour before an expert preparation . Chef Justin Champagne presented the bird&amp;rsquo ; s breast tender and crisp-skinned , while its dark meat was fashioned into a deep-fried croquette . The rest of the plate brimmed with treats , including saucy , umami-rich wheatberry risotto garnished with snails and truffled cheese . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : flash-fried duck with broccolini , chanterelles , corn , morcilla and blueberry jus at Fauna Food + Bar &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best rabbit&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34067;TOOLONG ... title= " Prosciutto wrapped rabbit saddle stuffed with mushroom/ braised leg croquette/ pickled carrots/ roasted carrots and carrot puree/ lemon aioli at Le St. Laurent " alt= " Prosciutto wrapped rabbit saddle stuffed with mushroom/ braised leg croquette/ pickled carrots/ roasted carrots and carrot puree/ lemon aioli at Le St. Laurent " data-portal-copyright= " Errol McGihon " **28;34103;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1418674 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Le St Laurent , chef Ryan Edwards combined prosciutto-wrapped , mushroom-stuffed medallions of rabbit with a crisp croquette of succulent braised leg meat , bolstered by lemon aioli or offset by some wild garlic . Pickled and roasted carrots rounded out the dish . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : rabbit dumplings with bone broth at Gray Jay &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best red **29;34133;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34164;TOOLONG ... title= " Brisket at Moes BBQ " alt= " Brisket at Moes BBQ " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;34200;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1353761 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Moe&amp;rsquo ; s BBQ in a South Keys mall , pitmaster Mobeen Butt turns out formidable southern-style smoked meats , despite never having tasted the food that inspired him . Why ? Because Butt&amp;rsquo ; s food is halal , while typical U.S. barbecue never follows that stricture . Nonetheless , Butt&amp;rsquo ; s smoked brisket was a thing of beauty , moist , thick-cut and beef-forward in flavour rather than heavily spiced or salted . &lt;br&gt; &lt;em&gt;Honourable mention&lt;/em&gt; : Oak-brined carpaccio with nori mayo and foie gras-spiked caramel corn at Bar Lupulus &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Best **32;34230;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34264;TOOLONG ... title= " Chocolate olive oil cake with carrot sorbet at Bar Lupulus " alt= " Chocolate olive oil cake with carrot sorbet at Bar Lupulus " data-portal-copyright= " Tony Caldwell " **28;34300;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1372038 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34330;TOOLONG ... title= " " ice cream sandwich " dessert at Alice " alt= " " ice cream sandwich " dessert at Alice " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;34366;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1462226 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34396;TOOLONG ... title= " Maple fondant , caramelized yogourt semifreddo , chanterelles at Gray Jay " alt= " Maple fondant , caramelized yogourt semifreddo , chanterelles at Gray Jay " data-portal-copyright= " Errol McGihon " **28;34432;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1483842 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Tie : I used to say Ottawa restaurants frequently fizzle when it comes to dessert . But this year , some ravishing , sophisticated creations ended a few of my meals . At Bar Lupulus , there was chocolate olive oil cake with pandan meringue inside , plus carrot sorbet with special fermented zip . At Alice , the kitchen&amp;rsquo ; s riff on an ice cream sandwich placed a quenelle of fermented rice-based &amp;ldquo ; ice cream&amp;rdquo ; between shards of hyper-crisp oat cake , buttressed by berries in a charred pine cone syrup . At Gray Jay , a startling dessert paired a molten ( but not overly sweet ) maple cake with a semifreddo made with sugar and dehydrated chanterelles and topped with mushroom morsels . Surprising ? &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;34618;TOOLONG " **32;34645;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; Peter HumThu , 19 Dec 2019 14:48:10 **45;34679;TOOLONG ... Food ReviewsDining Out : At Cumin Indian Grill in Centretown , street-food items satisfied mosthttp : **36;34726;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;34764;TOOLONG ... title= " Hariyali chicken at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Hariyali chicken at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;34800;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521182 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Cumin Indian Grill&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 373 Somerset St. W. , 613-695-6969 , &lt;a href= " http : **26;34830;TOOLONG " class= " fl " **33;34858;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Monday to Saturday 11:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. , and 5 to 9 p.m. , closed Sunday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; main dishes up to $15.99 &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; no steps to front door , washrooms on ground floor and downstairs &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; For most of the last decade , if not longer , the hole-in-the-wall at 373 Somerset St. W. was home to a modest Indian eatery called Basmati . Then , last year , it became Caf&amp;eacute ; Delish , which served crepes and waffles , but also Indian food . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; About eight months ago , the address reverted back to an exclusively Indian restaurant , an affordable place called Cumin Indian Grill . It recently caught my attention because its colourful renovations and menus with less-frequently-seen dishes suggested ambitions to raise the dining experience up a notch or two from what the previous tenant had offered . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Cumin , the two-storey space , which seats about 25 and is practically as tall as it is deep , now has violet walls and cyan tables , while a white , faux barn board wall now hides the sight of , if not the sounds of , the modest kitchen . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Those cyan tables are adorned with cloth napkins held snug with &lt;span class= " marko2zukmsj7 " &gt;Cumin&lt;/span&gt; -branded napkin rings . Edison lights hang on long strings , and the walls are adorned with stylized art . The place has a youthful feel its groovy South Asian pop soundtrack that comes with the music videos project overhead , on the eatery&amp;rsquo ; s back wall . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The restaurants lunch and dinner menus are not extensive , but they are still wide-ranging and not as curry-centric as more established Indian restaurants often are . In particular , I was glad to see some Indian street-food dishes and Hakka ( Indo-Chinese fusion ) dishes . Also , Cumin&amp;rsquo ; s meats confirm to halal practices . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The dishes that most hit the spot were hearty , rugged street-food items on Cumin&amp;rsquo ; s lunch menu . The Punjabi dish of chole bhature ( $13.99 ) , a combination of potently spiced , tomato-y chickpea curry and puffy , freshly fried flatbread , was a favourite at our table . Almost as good was the pav bhaji ( $7.99 ) , which served its thick potato-and-peas curry with soft buns . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34893;TOOLONG ... title= " Chole bhature ( Chickpea curry and fried flatbread ) at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Chole bhature ( Chickpea curry and fried flatbread ) at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;34929;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521734 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;34959;TOOLONG ... title= " Pav bhaji , a thick vegetable curry with a soft bread roll , at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Pav bhaji , a thick vegetable curry with a soft bread roll , at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;34995;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521712 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; We thought less of the aloo paratha ( $7.99 ) , because the flatbread&amp;rsquo ; s spiced potato filling was a little meagre . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35025;TOOLONG ... title= " Allo Paratha at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Allo Paratha at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35061;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521733 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; I was surprised but happy to see chicken dum biryani ( $15.99 ) offered at lunch , because I think of it as a labour-intensive rice dish fit for a evening&amp;rsquo ; s feast . Cumin&amp;rsquo ; s rendition delivered big flavours but felt more dry ( especially in the chicken department ) than the sublime chicken dum biryani that I&amp;rsquo ; ve had at NH44 in Ottawa&amp;rsquo ; s east end . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35091;TOOLONG ... title= " Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani ) at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum ' " alt= " Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani ) at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum ' " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35127;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521742 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Of the Hakka dishes , I was most curious to see how an Indian kitchen would make hot and sour soup ( $4.99 ) . It turned out the soup&amp;rsquo ; s broth had the look , gloss and savouriness of the Chinese-restaurant staple , but frozen vegetables stood in for meat , tofu and mushrooms . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35157;TOOLONG ... title= " Hot and sour soup at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Hot and sour soup at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35193;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521716 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Also from the Hakka selection , we liked the kitchen&amp;rsquo ; s versions of chicken 65 ( $14.99 ) and chilli chicken ( $14.99 ) , two dishes in which breaded , tender chicken morsels starred and which both had welcome spicy , sour stings . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35223;TOOLONG ... title= " Chicken 65 at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Chicken 65 at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35259;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521743 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35289;TOOLONG ... title= " Chilli chicken at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Chilli chicken at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35325;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521739 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Given that the eatery stresses its grill in its name , I had high hopes for its lamb chops ( $15.99 for two ) . They were more than fine &amp;mdash ; tender , highly seasoned and covered in a green , herbal sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35355;TOOLONG ... title= " Lamb chops at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Lamb chops at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35391;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521715 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; With the lamb chops and other dishes came massive quantities of basmati rice and some stir fried onions and peppers . This approach might suit single diners , but tables wishing for family-style sharing might want to ask for their food to be partitioned accordingly . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Also grilled and good was the hariyali chicken ( $13.99 ) , in which chunks of white meat were stained green by their herb-and-spice marinade and sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35421;TOOLONG ... title= " Hariyali chicken at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Hariyali chicken at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35457;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521717 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The lamb ( $13.99 ) and butter paneer curries ( $13.99 ) that we tried at lunch this week were substantially portioned but a little shallow of flavour . More rounded and complex was a beef Madras curry ( $14,99 ) that we had at dinner last week . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35487;TOOLONG ... title= " Butter paneer curry at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Butter paneer curry at Cumin Indian Grill , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35523;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521713 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35553;TOOLONG ... title= " Madras beef curry at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Madras beef curry at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35589;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521751 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Garlic naan bread ( $3.99 ) was a letdown because it seemed more like an unleavened flatbread that the leavened , charred treat that we had wanted . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;div dir= " auto " &gt; &lt;p&gt;The restaurant is licensed and serves a small selection of beers , affordable Ontario wines and some spirits . We had to try our first " dirty lassis " ( $7 ) , to see what a rum-spiked mango lassi was like . It turned out that our dirty lassi was more fun to say than to drink -- I prefer my lassis , dirty or not , to be colder and more sweet and creamy . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;A more appealing drink that was some meal-ending pink chai . The uncommon-in-Ottawa tea-based drink -- " You get this in Toronto , " our server said -- was sweet and pistachio-studded , even if it was not pink . I 'll be seeking it out again . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;35619;TOOLONG ... title= " Pink chai at Cumin Indian Grill " alt= " Pink chai at Cumin Indian Grill " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;35655;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1521714 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt;The round of pink chai was on the house at our dinner because of a serving mix-up , compensating us because we did not receive the coconut rice or biryani rice we had asked for with our curries.Service here has varied with personnel . Two servers have been on-point , while a third , while pleasant , was clearly inexperienced , unable to answer questions about dishes and not mindful about refilling water to help us assuage our spice-covered palates . At one visit , the un-busy kitchen fired out food quickly , but it was more slow to produce when the restaurant was more than half-full. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;In the end , although both service and food were hit-and-miss at Cumin Indian Grill . I 'm likely to return , given its best dishes and visible efforts . Plus , a server told me that a crab dish , I 'm guessing a South Indian spicy crab curry -- is bound for the menu in early 2020 . " data-portal-copyright= " Tony Caldwell " **28;36100;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1517340 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Bella 's Boys Italian Kitchen and Food Shop&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 250 Greenbank Rd. , Unit 12 , 613-695-1900 , &lt;a href= " http : //bellas.ca " &gt;bellas.ca&lt;/a&gt; ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Monday to Thursday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. , Friday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. , Saturday 10 a.m. to&amp;nbsp ; 4 p.m. , closed Sunday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; pastas $12 to $14 , paninis $8 to $11.50 , mains $16 &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; no steps to front door &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A year ago , I was all set to write a glowing review of Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro on Wellington Street West , which after two decades was still going strong and serving its much-liked and comforting Italian food to packed houses . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But the review , which would have included special kudos for chef-owner Raffaela &amp;ldquo ; Bella&amp;rdquo ; Milito&amp;rsquo ; s gnocchi with prosciutto and mushroom cream sauce as well as her classic tiramisu , never made it into print . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I had missed the memo that Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro needed to wind down its business . After 23 years , the restaurant closed last Dec. 31 , in advance of condo construction at Mizrahi Developments&amp;rsquo ; 1451 Wellington , which one day will go up where Bella&amp;rsquo ; s stood . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; All of this is backstory to a fine lunch I had last week . It consisted of gnocchi with prosciutto and mushroom cream sauce , followed by a block of tiramisu , all as good as what I&amp;rsquo ; d had at Bella&amp;rsquo ; s. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But of course it was . I had just lunched at Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys on Greenbank Road , which is run by Milito&amp;rsquo ; s three sons , Rob , Nick and Andrew . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The Militos opened their eatery , which focuses on take-home foods , catering jobs and eat-in lunches , in early September , not far from where they grew up . Their mother herself , who launched her own restaurant only after cooking in the 1980s at the Ritz on Elgin Street , still toils away in her boys&amp;rsquo ; large open kitchen , as does her husband , Gino. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Rob says that after his mother&amp;rsquo ; s restaurant closed , she &amp;ldquo ; was bored out of her mind . She was just going stir-crazy. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; This is what they do . This is what they love doing , &amp;rdquo ; he says of his parents , who are in their 70s and work as much as they want to with their sons . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The second generation&amp;rsquo ; s business lacks the intimate , old-house atmosphere that made Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro date night central for its regulars . However , the Bella&amp;rsquo ; s connection is visible , with the bistro&amp;rsquo ; s front door hanging on the food shop&amp;rsquo ; s wall and the sign from outside of the bistro , also salvaged before it was torn down , mounted above the fridges at the back of the shop . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Those keepsakes aside , the sons&amp;rsquo ; place is bright and utilitarian , a newly equipped commercial kitchen with just a few more than a dozen seats at small tables for its lunch crowd . The Militos and their staff are clad in black ball caps and T-shirts . While dine-in customers order at the front cash , their food , on paper plates , will be brought to them at their tables . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; On my first few visits to Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys , I was wowed by its panini sandwiches , which are not of the grilled variety but instead are distinguished by perfectly fresh and fluffy rolls that you wouldn&amp;rsquo ; t want to ruin by compressing them . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The bread that Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys uses is from the Bakery , a matter-of-factly named business a few stores away in the same Greenbank Road strip mall . These rolls were perfect for receiving tender , fresh meatballs ( $8.50 ) or chicken parm ( $9 ) , both bathed in fine red sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;36130;TOOLONG ... title= " Chicken Parm sandwich at Bella 's Boys , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Chicken Parm sandwich at Bella 's Boys , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;36166;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1517338 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys , everything but the bread , Rob said this week , is made from scratch on the premises . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The kitchen&amp;rsquo ; s pastas have consistently won me over with their freshness and balance of clear , clean flavours . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; ve always opted for stuffed pastas here , and found the spinach and ricotta manicotti ( $14 ) , beef and veal ravioli ( $14 ) and beef and veal cannelloni ( $14 ) to be well-made , toothsome winners that delivered all of the necessary comforts . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When it comes to lasagna , I have something approaching a phobia due to too many shoddy , self-destructing lasagnas I ate at my university&amp;rsquo ; s cafeteria years ago . The meat lasagna at Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Boys ( $12 ) eradicated that horrible memory with its tender flat noodles and substantial , zesty , meaty sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;36460;TOOLONG ... title= " Meat lasagna at Bella 's Boys " alt= " Meat lasagna at Bella 's Boys " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;36496;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1515877 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Gnocchi ( $13 ) was as fresh and tender as expected , and its enjoyable sauce was sufficiently rich and creamy that I was scraping every last bit of it off its paper plate . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;36526;TOOLONG ... title= " Gnocchi with proscuitto and mushroom cream sauce at Bella 's Boys " alt= " Gnocchi with proscuitto and mushroom cream sauce at Bella 's Boys " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;36562;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1515875 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; All of these pastas were favourites at Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro , Rob says . The same goes for the food shop&amp;rsquo ; s two chicken-based main courses , he adds . The &amp;ldquo ; chicken honey&amp;rdquo ; ( $16 ) was a perfectly cooked piece of chicken breast served with a creamy honey-mustard sauce of smack-you-in-the-face quality . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;36592;TOOLONG ... title= " Chicken Honey at Bella 's Boys " alt= " Chicken Honey at Bella 's Boys " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;36628;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1516390 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; There&amp;rsquo ; s a dessert counter beside the cash , and its contents also cast back to Bella&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro . Food ReviewsDining Out : In praise of Afghan kebab houses serving filling , casual , meaty mealshttp : **35;36972;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;37009;TOOLONG ... title= " chicken , beef and shami ( ground beef ) kebabs at Harir Kabab House , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " chicken , beef and shami ( ground beef ) kebabs at Harir Kabab House , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37045;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512446 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; **36;37075;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; 3098 Carling Ave. , Unit 8 , &lt;a href= " http : //mezbaan.restaurant " &gt;mezbaan.r ... &lt;br&gt; Open : Daily from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Harir Kabab House&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 2900 Woodroffe Ave. , Unit 9 , &lt;a href= " http : //harirkababhouse.com " &gt;harirkab ... &lt;br&gt; Open : Monday to Friday 10 a.m. to 10:30pm , ? Saturday 10:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. , Sunday 11 a.m. to&amp;nbsp ; 10:30 p.m. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Samar Kabab House&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 1-1729 Walkley Rd. , Unit 1 , &lt;a href= " http : //samarkabab.com " &gt;samarkabab.co ... &lt;br&gt; Open : Daily from 11 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When I&amp;rsquo ; m asked for dining-out recommendations , the question usually has to do where to go on date night , or to mark an anniversary , or where to take visitors from out of town . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But this time , it was a more plebeian query that stumped me. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; What restaurant would you recommend for a good working person&amp;rsquo ; s dinner ? &amp;rdquo ; I was asked . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; By that , she meant a restaurant she could pop into after her shift ended , a casual place that wasn&amp;rsquo ; t too expensive , that was fast , and that served good and generously portioned food . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; It took me a good week to come up with what I think is a smart answer to share with my questioner , and now with you . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; How about an Afghan kebab house ? &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; For some , this answer might be a little on the vague side . Which place do I mean ? &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Well , this fall I&amp;rsquo ; ve tried three of the newer Afghan eateries that have opened in suburban Ottawa strip malls and found them to be quite comparable , and good . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; For a no-fuss , working-person&amp;rsquo ; s meal , I can recommend Mezbaan on Carling Avenue , in the parking lot of Cineplex Cinemas Ottawa ; Harir Kabab House , which is in Barrhaven about half a kilometre from the SNMC Mosque ; and Samar Kabab House , which is on Walkley Road . Samar is the oldest of the three , having opened roughly two years ago , while the Barrhaven and west-end kebab houses have been open roughly six months or less . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; They join a handful of other Afghan restaurants in Ottawa , which have opened in roughly the last seven or eight years . Frankly , the three I recently tried and several others I&amp;rsquo ; ve reviewed over the years have been remarkably similar , in terms of what their menus offer and the flavour profiles and quality of the food on their all-day menus . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The specialties at any of these restaurants is , of course , grilled halal-butchered meats , including lamb , beef , both ground or in chunks , and chicken , both ground or in chunks . The prices for kebab platters can range from $15 or so up to about $25 , depending on the kind and quantity of meat you want . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; ve not received a sub-par kebab at any of my recent visits . On my kebab honour roll were exceptionally juicy kebabs during a visit to Samar in the east end , when we were the only customers at lunch . At a recent lunch visit to Mezbaan in the west end , while the chicken thigh kebab offered on the menu wasn&amp;rsquo ; t available , the chicken breast kebab was seconds-off-the-grill moist , and blessed with fine tandoori seasoning . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37113;TOOLONG ... title= " Lamb kebab at Mezbaan " alt= " Lamb kebab at Mezbaan " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37149;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512450 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37179;TOOLONG ... title= " Kebab combo at Mezbaan " alt= " Kebab combo at Mezbaan " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37215;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512451 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37245;TOOLONG ... title= " Chicken , beef and shami ( ground beef ) kebabs at Harir Kabab House " alt= " Chicken , beef and shami ( ground beef ) kebabs at Harir Kabab House " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37281;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512446 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At one visit to Harir in Barrhaven , the kebabs were uniformly more spicy , but given the more temperate meats I later tried , those more potent kebabs might have been a one-off . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Harir and Samar also offer torsh kebabs , a more expensive preparation I think of as Persian , in which chunks of beef are made tangy and sweet with a pomegranate-walnut marinade . If I had a craving for them , I&amp;rsquo ; d go out of my way for Samar&amp;rsquo ; s torsh kebabs. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37311;TOOLONG ... title= " Toorsh kabab at Harir Kabab House " alt= " Toorsh kabab at Harir Kabab House " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37347;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512536 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; In generally , the kebabs at Samar , which is the largest and fanciest of these three restaurants , are a little bit pricier , but not unfairly so . Harir seems to have the lowest prices . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We&amp;rsquo ; ve always ordered our kebabs with seasoned , fluffy basmati rice and fresh , simple salad , dressed with a lightly creamy dressing , and found our plates brimming with food . A cheaper , less filling option would be to order kebabs in wraps. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Smaller appetites might also go for one of the stewed dishes ( usually around $8 or $9 ) offered at each of the restaurants that attest to Afghanistan&amp;rsquo ; s proximity to northern India &amp;mdash ; mellow butter chicken or runnier , more tomato-y chicken , beef or eggplant qorma. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Side dishes ( usually between $7 and $9 ) that always appealed included sabzi , a stew of spinach with dill , coriander and cilantro , qabelli rice , made more festive with the addition of nuts , carrots and raisins , and steamed mantu dumplings , filled with well-fried ground beef and lamb . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37377;TOOLONG ... title= " Sabzi at Mezbaan " alt= " Sabzi at Mezbaan " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37413;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512533 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37443;TOOLONG ... title= " Sabzi at Harir Kabab House " alt= " Sabzi at Harir Kabab House " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37479;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512537 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37509;TOOLONG ... title= " Mantu dumplings at Harir Kabab House " alt= " Mantu dumplings at Harir Kabab House " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37545;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512675 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37575;TOOLONG ... title= " Qabelli rice at Mezbaan " alt= " Qabelli rice at Mezbaan " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37611;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512684 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Freshly made Afghan naan bread &amp;mdash ; ovals with a coloured , crisp exterior and soft , yielding crumb &amp;mdash ; came with every meal . In particular , Mezbaan&amp;rsquo ; s bread emerged piping hot . Bolani ( between $6.49 and $8 ) , which I&amp;rsquo ; ve tried and enjoyed at Mezbaan and Harir , is a thinner , softer bread stuffed with a potato filling of varying pepperiness. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;37641;TOOLONG ... title= " Bolani at Harir Kabab House " alt= " Bolani at Harir Kabab House " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;37677;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1512664 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; ve had just a few small quibbles . At Samar , the ash-e-reshteh&amp;nbsp ; soup of noodles , beans , chickpeas and herbs seemed muted of flavour and limp-noodled . At Harir , we wanted to try the chicken karahi , which from the photo in the menu involved a well-marinated and spiced bird&amp;rsquo ; s meaningful encounter with a wok-like vessel . However , we were told the deluxe dish ( $28.99 ) that I associate with Pakistan and India wasn&amp;rsquo ; t available because the chef who knew the recipe had the day off . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; However , the quality of Harir&amp;rsquo ; s tender and well-seasoned lamb chops was more than enough of a consolation . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The restaurants are not licensed but there are thirst-quenching drinks such as the massive , well-chilled mango lassis at Harir or the alcohol-free , flavoured Barbican beer at Samar. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Harir and Samar both offer children&amp;rsquo ; s menus , and all three restaurants can scale up their output to serve kebabs en masse in family packs for as many as 20 people . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Desserts at these restaurants are simple , ranging from firnee , a small serving of milk pudding sprinkled with cardamom , to the ice creams and cheesecake at Samar. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But these sweet meal-enders have struck me as optional , and I&amp;rsquo ; ve rarely had enough appetite left to try them . If you , or any other working person , leave an Afghan restaurant hungry or unsatisfied , then you&amp;rsquo ; ve probably done something wrong . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;37707;TOOLONG " **32;37734;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; &lt;a href= " http : //twitter.com/peterhum " &gt;twitter ... &lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;ALSO IN THE ARTS AND LIFE &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;37768;TOOLONG ... " alt= " Sous-chef Kathryn Ferries poses for a photo at Stofa restaurant in Ottawa Wednesday Nov 20 , 2019. " data-portal-copyright= " Tony Caldwell " **28;37987;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1510045 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Kathryn Ferries , the 27-year-old sous chef at Stofa Restaurant on Wellington Street West , came home a winner after competing at the recent S.Pellegrino Young Chef Competition in New York . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; While Ferries didn&amp;rsquo ; t come first outright among the 10 North American competitors invited to cook and serve their signature dishes to judges , she did win the social responsibility award , and with it , a trip to the competition&amp;rsquo ; s Grand Finale in Milan , Italy next year . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Below , Ferries , a Winnipeg native who has lived in Ottawa for 15 years and who graduated from Le Cordon Bleu Ottawa Culinary Institute , discusses why she cooks and competes and what her long-term ambitions are . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Q : What prompted you to take part in the competition ? &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A : I enjoy the way competitions give chefs new challenges and a change of pace from the regular restaurant hustle . It&amp;rsquo ; s appealing to create a dish that&amp;rsquo ; s truly representative of your beliefs and tastes and then walk into an unknown kitchen and produce that dish at the highest level . It&amp;rsquo ; s cooking solely off your knowledge and talent , using the ability to manage stress and nerves while also engaging with the guests who are lucky enough to watch you cook for five hours . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I also follow San Pellegrino&amp;rsquo ; s 50 Best Lists every year , and the exceptional talent that makes those lists plays a part in how they approach their standards for the young chef competition . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;38017;TOOLONG ... title= " The dish is the Forest Glazed Rabbit Ballotine with Fennel , Chanterelles , Coco Blanco and Mustard Greens , created by the young Ottawa chef Kathryn Ferries . " alt= " The dish is the Forest Glazed Rabbit Ballotine with Fennel , Chanterelles , Coco Blanco and Mustard Greens , created by the young Ottawa chef Kathryn Ferries . " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;38053;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1510065 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Q : Tell me about your signature dish . &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A : My dish for the competition was black garlic and herb rabbit ballotine glazed with forest honey , served with fennel sauerkraut , chanterelle conserva , coco blanco puree , pomelo preserve and treviso radicchio . It&amp;rsquo ; s garnished with toasted almonds , pumpernickel crisps , mustard greens and anise hyssop and served with a rabbit jus made with marsala wine and warm spices , split with a bright green chive oil . We commissioned plates and jus pourers to complement the style of the dish , made by a friend of chef Jason Sawision , who also created some of the plateware we have at ( his restaurant ) Stofa. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I don&amp;rsquo ; t see rabbit used on many menus , at least in Ottawa , which is unfortunate since it is such a versatile protein that can take on many different flavours and cuisines . This dish is reflective of my French training but updated to showcase the style of plating I currently enjoy . It&amp;rsquo ; s classic in ingredient pairings , but with small twists to add interest . For example , using pomelo instead of lemon in the preserve , creating sauerkraut out of fennel instead of cabbage , and using black garlic to not only create visual contrast on the inside of the ballotine but to also give the rabbit an earthy flavour that plays between the elements on the dish . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I knew I wanted to showcase techniques that usually you would shy away from in a five-hour time window , as well as take advantage of the new rule allowing preserves , ferments , and dehydrated products to be brought to the competition . You can really layer a dish with flavour instead of being confined to what can be created solely within the competition time . I am happy with the result , but am looking forward to getting started on next year&amp;rsquo ; s submission . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Q : How did the competition go ? Were you nervous ? &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A : Lots of practice , preparation and organization went into this competition in the months and weeks leading up to New York , so most of my nerves were non-existent , which was fantastic because I got to really enjoy the event . As with all competitions , not everything goes according to plan , but as a first-time competitor , it was a fantastic experience that I hope to get the chance to experience again . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;5 ) What did it mean for you to win the social responsibility award ? &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; It&amp;rsquo ; s a great award to have won for this dish , as it really follows the principles of not wasting food , cooking within the seasons and using ingredients that don&amp;rsquo ; t create harm to our planet . This dish highlights whole-animal butchery and is intentionally low-waste , ensuring any leftover ingredients made their way into the stock or were reused on the plate ( mirepoix for stock , chives trimmings into oil , rabbit bones for stock ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; There are many more steps to take to reduce waste in our industry , but to be recognized for making the effort to create change is a huge honour . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Q : What other culinary ambitions do you have ? &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A : It&amp;rsquo ; s still early in my career , so I seem to keep collecting more ideas . But for now , ( my ) long term ( goal ) is to have a restaurant , or a few , of my own one day . In the meantime , I would love to continue to travel and learn from the many talented chefs in the world , as well as work closer with chefs in Ottawa to showcase all the talent we have here at home . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Ottawa shouldn&amp;rsquo ; t be looked over as much as it is . As we&amp;rsquo ; ve shown time and time again , we are much more than our stereotype of the sleepy , government town . There are so many amazing chefs and restaurants in this city who deserve recognition on a larger stage . I look forward to the day that an Ottawa restaurant is No. 1 on all the lists , in this country and others . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; phum@postmedia.com &lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt; **33;38083;TOOLONG &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;38118;TOOLONG ... But what do they really mean by that ? &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Dig a little deeper into their menus and you&amp;rsquo ; ll usually see Lebanese dips , pies or platters . At other restaurants , Greek salads and appetizers prevail , or perhaps pizzas and pastas. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; And then there&amp;rsquo ; s Bistro Ristoro , which has been open for more than a year in the ByWard Market , near the quieter , western end of Clarence Street . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Its all-day menu , which I&amp;rsquo ; ve sampled from twice this fall , takes its own tour of Mediterranean countries , offering an assortment of thin-crust pizzas and bread-y items from its visible brick oven imported from Italy , plus a smattering of Greek dishes , pastas and salads . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Plus , because the restaurant&amp;rsquo ; s owner-operators are from North Macedonia , the landlocked Balkan country that doesn&amp;rsquo ; t touch the Mediterranean Sea but is just north of Greece , the bistro &amp;mdash ; perhaps most interestingly &amp;mdash ; serves some Balkan dishes that you&amp;rsquo ; ll be hard-pressed to find elsewhere in Ottawa . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; At least , if someone knows another Ottawa eatery that serves plieskavitza ( a spiced , half-pound beef patty that&amp;rsquo ; s widely&amp;nbsp ; cherished in the Balkans ) , could you please let me know , as I would then have something with which to compare Bistro Ristoro&amp;rsquo ; s rendition . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We first visited Bistro Ristoro for lunch , when we found its dishes simple , generously portioned and a little hit and miss . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; One carnivore at my table was pleased with his baked pork tenderloin ( $24 ) , which was a touch overdone but nonetheless tasty thanks to its white wine mushroom cream sauce . Food ReviewsChef Ian Carswell of Black Tartan Kitchen wins Ottawa qualifier for the 2020 Canadian Culinary Championshipshttp : **27;39216;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;39245;TOOLONG ... title= " Ian Carswell prepared Milkhouse Lamb as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party " to represent Ottawa in the 2020 Canadian Culinary Championships . " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;39281;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1508875 " /&gt; &lt;iframe width= " 100% " height= " 100% " frameborder= " 0 " allowfullscreen= " true " src= " https : **34;39311;TOOLONG ... &gt; &lt;/iframe&gt; &lt;p&gt; Chef Ian Carswell of Black Tartan Kitchen prevailed over seven other Ottawa-area chefs Tuesday night at the Ottawa edition of Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Great Kitchen Party , the event known in past years as Gold Medal Plates . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Held at Signatures , the restaurant of Le Cordon Bleu Ottawa Culinary Arts Institute in Sandy Hill , Tuesday&amp;rsquo ; s qualifier will send Carswell to compete at the 2020 Canadian Culinary Championships . That multi-day event will be held in late January next year in Ottawa . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In second place was chef Ben Landreville of Sidedoor , the upscale Asian-themed restaurant in the ByWard Market . He served his version of banh khoai , a Vietnamese pancake , with spot prawns , pork sausage and fungus , nuoc mam cham , preserved vegetables and fresh herbs . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In third place was Daniela Manrique of Soca Kitchen on Holland Avenue . She served chile-rubbed and smoked beef tenderloin with hazelnut romesco sauce , shaved raw artichoke , fermented black garlic and white soy vinaigrette and uni , port , pear p&amp;acirc ; t&amp;eacute ; br&amp;ucirc ; l&amp;eacute ; e . Her dish also won the event&amp;rsquo ; s people&amp;rsquo ; s choice award . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The other chefs competing were Shane Brown of Beckta Dining and Wine on Elgin Street , Justin Champagne of Bar Lupulus on Wellington Street West , Billy Khoo of Fauna Food + Bar in Centretown , Razmon Poisson of Orto Trattoria in the Glebe and Jason Sawision of Stofa on Wellington Street West . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; At last year&amp;rsquo ; s Ottawa event , Manrique came in second while Sawision finished third . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; As in past years , I took it upon myself to pit my palate against the assessments of the judges , who , to be fair , would be more rigorous and less gut-driven than I was . Below are my takes on the dishes , beginning with my least favourite and ending with my favourite . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;39347;TOOLONG ... title= " Razmon Poisson prepared Smoked Sea Urchin as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party . " " alt= " Razmon Poisson prepared Smoked Sea Urchin as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party . " " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;39383;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1508844 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; * Razmon Poisson of Orto Trattoria in the Glebe served smoked sea urchin with tamarind maple glaze , &amp;ldquo ; tom yum&amp;rdquo ; sorbet , chicken skin shard , duck fat snow and umami sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I love the bracing , briny delicacy of sea urchin and was looking forward to this dish . However , I felt there was just too much going on , and the tom yum sorbet overshadowed the uni . This dish was creative and had some well-executed components , including the crispy chicken skin and duck fat snow . But I didn&amp;rsquo ; t get a sense of perfect harmony from all of the components . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;39413;TOOLONG ... title= " Billy Khoo prepared Smoked Sablefish as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party . " " alt= " Billy Khoo prepared Smoked Sablefish as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party . " " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;39449;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1508845 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; * Billy Khoo of Fauna Food + Bar in Centretown served smoked sablefish rolled in green strawberry ash and served with sablefish consomm&amp;eacute ; pearls , salsify and house-made miso pur&amp;eacute ; e , green strawberry chutney , preserved lemon foam , cured sablefish skin , and fried salsify nest . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I like sablefish as much as I like uni , but again , I thought the star of the plate arrived over-dressed . This entry had technique and creativity in its favour , but not all of its components felt essential . While I admired the concept of making maximum use of sablefish , strawberry and salsify , the smoking of the fish and bitterness from the strawberry ash obscured the beautiful natural flavour of the fish . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;39479;TOOLONG ... title= " Ben Landreville prepares Banh Khoai " Vietnames Happy Pancake " as eight local chefs compete at the Ottawa edition of the 2019 " Canada 's Great Kitchen Party . " " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;39515;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1508838 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; * Ben Landreville of Sidedoor , the upscale Asian-themed restaurant in the ByWard Market , served his version of banh khoai , a Vietnamese pancake , with spot prawns , pork sausage and fungus , nuoc mam cham , preserved vegetables and fresh herbs . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; This entry was pleasant , punchy of flavour and did have the ring of truth in terms of Vietnamese flavour profiles . After trying all eight dishes , Sawision&amp;rsquo ; s dish was the one I clearly was craving to sample again , and I happily had seconds . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The eight chefs served a panel of judges that included Kitchen Parry head judge James Chatto , cookbook author and former Citizen restaurant critic Anne Desbrisay , Algonquin College culinary program professor and chef Cory Haskins , Thyme &amp;amp ; Again owner Sheila Whyte , culinary historian Janet Boileau , chef Marc Lepine of Atelier , a two-time winner of the Canadian Culinary Championships , and chef Yannick LaSalle of Les Foug&amp;egrave ; res in Chelsea , who won in Ottawa last year and then at the national championships this year . Lepine was not allowed to judge the entries from chefs Sawision and Champagne , who had previously worked for him at Atelier . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The event attracted a sold-out crowd of about 150 food-lovers who scuttled from room to room in the restaurant of Le Cordon Bleu Ottawa Culinary Arts Institute on Laurier Avenue East , which was hosting the annual event for the first time . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Compared to what was available in past years at the Shaw Centre&amp;rsquo ; s expansive ballroom , the working and serving space for chefs was more limited , too , which likely heightened the challenge of assembling refined creations with just a few hot plates available for last-minute cooking . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Held this fall in a dozen cities across the country , the Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Great Kitchen Party events are successors to the long-running Gold Medal Plates competitions , which were fundraisers for Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Olympic athletes as well as celebrations of chefs and haute cuisine . Fortunately , Fauna in Centretown could still take us for an early evening reservation . Luckier still , our meal turned out to be a contender for my best restaurant dinner in Ottawa this year . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We did go to Fauna with high hopes , although the last time I&amp;rsquo ; d eaten there was in late 2014 , soon after its chef-owner Jon Svazas opened it . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Since 2014 , there have been accolades and tweaks at Fauna . It cracked the Canada&amp;rsquo ; s 100 Best Restaurants list in 2016 , 2017 and this year . Given that Svazas opened Bar Laurel in Hintonburg in 2016 , Fauna&amp;rsquo ; s chef de cuisine Billy Khoo plays a greater role now , and next Tuesday , it will be Khoo rather than Svazas who will lead the kitchen crew from Fauna next Tuesday at Ottawa&amp;rsquo ; s edition of Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Great Kitchen Party , the regional qualifier for next year&amp;rsquo ; s Canadian Culinary Championships . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In 2014 , Fauna was all about small plates . Today , it serves mains and even big dishes for two or more , and I was curious to see what the restaurant would do with dishes of that scale . Ultimately , regardless of plate size , the way to go seems to be to share . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Our meal&amp;rsquo ; s strong , cool start consisted of two raw dishes , although they arrived so quickly from the kitchen that they beat the well-made but lagging cocktails to our table . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Bison tartare ( $19 ) wowed us with the quality of its finely chopped meat , its different gradations of acid , fat , sweetness and umami , its crisp potato chips and its striking plating . &amp;ldquo ; I could eat that all night , &amp;rdquo ; said one of my friends . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;40131;TOOLONG ... title= " Bison tartare at Fauna " alt= " Bison tartare at Fauna " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;40167;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1505715 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; More delicate was the swordfish ceviche ( $19 ) , a distinct departure from the rustic , boldly flavoured , chunky , Peruvian-style ceviches that typically win me over . Fauna&amp;rsquo ; s ceviche impressed with its finesse and calibration , its mild fish artfully wrapped in cucumber and nestled in a flavourful pool of coconut milk , chili and herb oil . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;40197;TOOLONG ... title= " Swordfish ceviche at Fauna " alt= " Swordfish ceviche at Fauna " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;40233;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1507039 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Two warm small plates continued the kitchen&amp;rsquo ; s streak . Shishito peppers ( $20 ) stuffed with scrumptious lamb played on chile rellenos , and came with a complex mole sauce that delivered lingering heat . A plump , whole soft shell crab ( $20 ) received a marvellously crisp tempura treatment , while the seaweed aioli and a sprinkling of spice blend added punch to the crustacean&amp;rsquo ; s already intense flavour . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Five years ago , I called Fauna , which seats about 60 at its woody tables and wraparound bar , the loveliest new dining room in town . It still feels vibrant and au courant , with its textured walls , massive and funky art and fun lighting fixtures . Downstairs , a private dining room provides an alternate setting . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I also noted in 2014 that Fauna is a little darker than I like , and grows louder than I like , and these aspects of the ambience have remained constant . Being seated beside one of the huge windows looking onto Bank Street at my recent dinner did make for a slightly brighter and more isolated experience . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The bar&amp;rsquo ; s offering of 10 craft cocktails is wide and intriguing , while the lengthy and discerning wine list here favours natural , biodynamic and organic bottles . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Overall , Fauna at five feels like a restaurant that can execute and serve its many strengths with easy , knowing confidence . Rodriguez becomes chef of the Grill 41 restaurant in the Lord Elgin Hotelhttp : **35;40896;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;40933;TOOLONG ... title= " Top Chef Canada 's 2014 winner , Rene Rodriguez. " alt= " Top Chef Canada 's 2014 winner , Rene Rodriguez. " data-portal-copyright= " Sabrina Bedford " **28;40969;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1500904 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The venerable Lord Elgin Hotel has hired veteran Ottawa chef Ren&amp;eacute ; Rodriguez to helm the kitchen of its Grill 41 restaurant . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Rodriquez is known nationally for winning the 2014 season of the Top Chef Canada TV series . He has cooked in Ottawa since at least the early 2000s at many of the city&amp;rsquo ; s leading restaurants , and most notably he owned and operated Navarra , which drew upon the cuisine of Rodriguez&amp;rsquo ; s Mexican heritage , for nearly a decade in the ByWard Market until it closed in the spring of 2017. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; After Navarra closed , Rodriguez was hired as the chef who opened the Italian restaurant Orto Trattoria in the Glebe . He then moved on to help open Mercadito , the Mexican street food eatery in the Queen St. Fare food hall . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; According to a release , Rodriguez has been working for the past several few months with the Grill 41 team to create new menu items . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; I&amp;rsquo ; m thrilled to be leading a kitchen of hard-working pros whose ambition is to amaze every guest , &amp;rdquo ; Rodriguez says in the release . &amp;ldquo ; One of the many things I&amp;rsquo ; ve learned in my career is the kitchen staff must work together like a professional team . We must all bring our strengths to the table , and my job is to bring out the very best in each of us. &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Some of Rodriguez&amp;rsquo ; s dishes , which will be designated with &amp;ldquo ; RR&amp;rdquo ; on Grill 41&amp;rsquo ; s menu , will include watercress salad with cured albacore tuna gravlax , with Spanish paprika deviled egg and olive powder ; Grill 41 Signature Steak Tartare with pearl onion marmalade , crostini , sorrel and celeriac tuile ; seared sea scallops with Granny Smith apple emulsion , parsnip leather and lovage ; and steak frites with Roquefort butter , house fries , espelette aioli and herb salad . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Located close to Confederation Park and the Rideau Canal , the Lord Elgin Hotel was built in 1941. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;ALSO IN ARTS AND LIFE&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;40999;TOOLONG ... things you ca n't miss in Abadakone , the National Gallery 's exhibition of contemporary Indigenous art&lt;/a&gt; &lt;strong&gt; &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;41034;TOOLONG ... Out : Luxurious , hedonistic eating at Gitanes on Elgin Street&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt; Peter HumThu , 07 Nov 2019 20:38:43 **45;41104;TOOLONG ... Out : Luxurious , hedonistic eating at Gitanes on Elgin Streethttp : **34;41151;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;41187;TOOLONG ... title= " Mitch Lacombe is the Chef de Cuisine at Gitanes on Elgin Street . Julie Oliver/Postmedia " alt= " Mitch Lacombe is the Chef de Cuisine at Gitanes on Elgin Street . Julie Oliver/Postmedia " data-portal-copyright= " Julie Oliver " **28;41223;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496428 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; **36;41253;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; 361-6 Elgin St. , 613-562-0699 , &lt;a href= " http : //gitanes.co " &gt;gitanes.co&lt;/a &; ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Tuesday to Saturday 5 p.m. to 2 a.m. , closed Sunday and Monday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; appetizers $7 to $45 , mains $22 to $70 &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; restaurant is below street level , steps or long ramp to front door &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; As the cool kids like to say , the menu at Gitanes was lit. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Or rather , as a more literal adult would say , the menu , a large paper card filled with beguiling choices , was lit on fire last week after my dining companion allowed it to hover too close to our table&amp;rsquo ; s tiny candle . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Our server was sympathetic . She told us this was roughly the eighth case of a menu catching fire since Gitanes opened in mid-September on Elgin Street , in a much renovated space where Oz Kafe , now in the ByWard Market , had been . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; That&amp;rsquo ; s the first warning I will share about Gitanes . Don&amp;rsquo ; t set your menu on fire . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The second warning : At Gitanes , which broadly speaking is a French-inspired restaurant , the food can be very rich . Both the French onion soup and the bordelaise sauce that comes with the massive O&amp;rsquo ; Brien Farms ribeye are enriched with bone marrow . There&amp;rsquo ; s a puddle of foie gras mousse beside the truffle-sauced chicken and even foie gras incorporated , quite subtly , into the ice cream sundae . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41291;TOOLONG ... title= " French onion soup with bone marrow at Gitanes on Elgin Street " alt= " French onion soup with bone marrow at Gitanes on Elgin Street " data-portal-copyright= " Julie Oliver " **28;41327;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496549 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Of course , foie gras and truffles aren&amp;rsquo ; t cheap . Accordingly , my third warning is that it will help you at Gitanes if you are rich or at least enjoy feeling rich . It is a youthful , casual and fun place , but also a splurge if you want to do more than nibble on some shrimp tartare ( $10 ) and impeccably crisp , salted and herb-enhanced fries with aioli and ketchup ( $8 for a generous portion ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41357;TOOLONG ... title= " French fries with aioli and ketchup at Gitanes " alt= " French fries with aioli and ketchup at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41393;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496417 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Main courses can easily top $40 here . Seafood towers from the cold bar are $90 and $125 , with a $90 supplement for caviar . For the most celebratory guests , Gitanes stocks 11 champagnes , including 2011 Pierre Peters &amp;ldquo ; Les Ch&amp;eacute ; tillons&amp;rdquo ; Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut at $355 a bottle . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But after all these caveats , I still recommend Gitanes , as long as you know what you&amp;rsquo ; re in for . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; After Thru , Alice and Gray Jay , it is the fourth very notable restaurant to open in Ottawa since the spring of this year . They are all different . Gitanes , perhaps apropos of being on Elgin Street , is less high-minded than the others . But , at its best , Gitanes is more about food as a direct , carnal pleasure as well as a sophisticated indulgence . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; That was our conclusion as we extracted briny , potent Rimouski-raised sea urchin from their shells ( two for $25 ) and smeared the orange ambrosia ( gonads , yes I know ) on some miniature miso-buttered English muffins . For umami overload , the iced platter also contained some uni mayo , which by itself made our eyes widen . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41423;TOOLONG ... title= " Sea urchin with miso butter , uni mayo and English muffins at Gitanes " alt= " Sea urchin with miso butter , uni mayo and English muffins at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41459;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496550 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Stored wrong or out of the water too long , sea urchin is really off-putting and tastes of iodine . I&amp;rsquo ; ve had several bad uni experiences at restaurants , but Gitanes&amp;rsquo ; uni could not have been more fresh and mind-altering. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I don&amp;rsquo ; t have the budget to have tried all 11 items from the cold seafood bar , which is out front at Gitanes , separate from the kitchen , but I&amp;rsquo ; ll be saving up for snow crab and lobster . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I did try some of the more composed raw-fish items and they were very good , if not as transcendental as the admittedly acquired taste of uni . Slabs of mackerel ( $14 ) were unctuous and earthy , perked by fermented rhubarb , hazelnut and serrano chiles and sitting in a bright sauce of fermented plum and ponzu . Tuna tartare ( $20 ) was well-made &amp;mdash ; finely chopped , clean and mild of taste and elevated by the right amount of plum gel&amp;eacute ; e , cr&amp;egrave ; me fra&amp;icirc ; che and bits of crisped sunchoke. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41489;TOOLONG ... title= " Mackerel with fermented rhubarb , toasted hazelnut , serrano and shiso " alt= " Mackerel with fermented rhubarb , toasted hazelnut , serrano and shiso " data-portal-copyright= " Julie Oliver " **28;41525;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496531 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41555;TOOLONG ... title= " Tuna tartare at Gitanes " alt= " Tuna tartare at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " Julie Oliver " **28;41591;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496561 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Beef tartare ( $20 ) , while not so appetizing-looking , was simple and fine , its meat tucked under a layer of bigger sunchoke crisps . I&amp;rsquo ; m used to a bit more acid in my tartares , but in my experience , that&amp;rsquo ; s not how Gitanes rolls . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41621;TOOLONG ... title= " Beef tartare with sunchokes at Gitanes " alt= " Beef tartare with sunchokes at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41657;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496432 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Celery root and apple &amp;mdash ; a classic pairing &amp;mdash ; starred in a lower-key but satisfying salad ( $16 ) . The vegetable and fruit were crisp and thinly sliced , bolstered by a creamy dressing that had the nuttiness of brown butter going for it , while bits of cheddar added their pop to the dish . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41687;TOOLONG ... title= " Apple celery root salad at Gitanes " alt= " Apple celery root salad at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41723;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496430 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; That menu that nearly went up in flames boasts 16 appetizers and vegetable dishes , but we skipped intriguing options such as escargots , that French onion soup and duck boudin sausage to tuck into some of the big-money mains ( as opposed to the cheaper burger or steak frites ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A massive chicken breast received a deluxe treatment ( $47 ) . It was blissfully moist after being cooked sous vide and then roasted , and its truffled sauce , cinnamon cap mushrooms and foie gras mousse made for an opulently rich main , offset only by the tangy hint of fermented elderberry. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41753;TOOLONG ... title= " Chicken with mushrooms , foie gras , perigord sauce at Gitanes " alt= " Chicken with mushrooms , foie gras , perigord sauce at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41789;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496536 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; On my second visit , a buddy and I split the uber-beefy O&amp;rsquo ; Brien Farms 16-ounce ribeye ( $70 ) , also showered with mushrooms plus some cippolinis , and served with the dark , beefy-in-its-own right , marrow-infused bordelaise . We felt like the world&amp;rsquo ; s most decadent carnivores. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41819;TOOLONG ... title= " O'Brien Farms ribeye for two with mushrooms and onions at Gitanes " alt= " O'Brien Farms ribeye for two with mushrooms and onions at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41855;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496424 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Even more tongue-catching and pleasing was the **25;41885;TOOLONG sauce with Gitanes&amp;rsquo ; dry-aged duck breast ( $40 ) that had a bit of extra funk to it , and was tender , if a touch overdone . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41912;TOOLONG ... title= " Dry-aged duck breast at Gitanes " alt= " Dry-aged duck breast at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;41948;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1495845 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Flawless was the big chunk of roasted halibut ( $47 ) with stewed beans , a quenelle of herby sauce , with clams and chanterelles along for the ride . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;41978;TOOLONG ... title= " Roasted halibut with beans , chanterelles and green sauce at Gitanes " alt= " Roasted halibut with beans , chanterelles and green sauce at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;42014;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496532 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The sundae made with foie gras ice cream ( $19 ) was very creamy and barely liver-y , but it delivered a wave of sweet , boozy excess , with its rum-spiked bananas Foster sauce and bourbon-soaked cherry . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;42044;TOOLONG ... title= " Foie gras ice cream sundae at Gitanes , pic by Peter Hum " alt= " Foie gras ice cream sundae at Gitanes , pic by Peter Hum " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;42080;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496418 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Restrained by comparison was a dark , smooth slice of chocolate tart ( $10 ) covered with ground cherries . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;42110;TOOLONG ... title= " Chocolate ground cherry tart at Gitanes " alt= " Chocolate ground cherry tart at Gitanes " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;42146;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1496433 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Service was always personable , assured and knowledgeable about the food and beverages , significantly adding to our enjoyment . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The restaurant seats about 50 people in distinctly different spaces . I&amp;rsquo ; ve sat twice at the back , near the kitchen , in an area with a cellar-y feel under exposed ducts where we wished the very diverse piped-in music was somewhat quieter and the lights were a little brighter . That said , our space was softened by an area graced by sofa seating for about eight , not that we were that uncomfortable in our curvy moulded plastic chairs . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I envied the people at the front of the restaurant , who could watch the cook at the raw bar station . I really envied the folks at the chef&amp;rsquo ; s table right in the kitchen , treating themselves to the $95-per-person tasting menu . There&amp;rsquo ; s also a darker lounge-y bar area with a few tables . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Gitanes is co-owned by Nader Salib , who also has a stake in Common Eatery , a block south on Elgin Street . His co-owner is American chef Luke Reyes , who splits his time between Los Angeles and Ottawa . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Chef de cuisine Mitch Lacombe definitely deserves kudos . Having been the chef de cuisine at Restaurant E18hteen and sous chef at Riviera , Lacombe is no stranger to high-end dishes that smack of luxury . He is definitely helping to rocket Gitanes into the elite company of his previous kitchens . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;42176;TOOLONG " **32;42203;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; &lt;a href= " http : //twitter.com/peterhum " &gt;twitter ... &lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;ALSO IN THE NEWS&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;42237;TOOLONG ...
