But that&amp;rsquo ; s pretty dangerous in terms of the responsibility to the food culture you&amp;rsquo ; re working with . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; He says he allows himself to tinker with authentic recipes if the new creations point to Canadian and Quebecois comfort food . Hence , there&amp;rsquo ; s his tourti&amp;egrave ; re egg rolls , or barbecue pork that&amp;rsquo ; s glazed with maple syrup rather than the usual honey . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; To me , authenticity isn&amp;rsquo ; t just about accurate replication , &amp;rdquo ; Hassan says . &amp;ldquo ; It&amp;rsquo ; s about honouring that food trajectory and understanding it . Someone can take something and evolve it , whether it&amp;rsquo ; s to adapt to locally available foods or to local palate preferences , and still be mindful of where it&amp;rsquo ; s coming from and make sure people can see where it&amp;rsquo ; s coming from and where it&amp;rsquo ; s going . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; *** &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Earlier this year , when I spoke to the Ottawa-born , Toronto-raised celebrity chef Amanda Cohen , she spoke excitedly about the food scene in Canada . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; While Cohen cooks principally at her renowned New York restaurant , a mecca for vegetable lovers called Dirt Candy , she returns to Canada for cooking events , and is a titular competitor on the Iron Chef : Canada TV series . What strikes her most about food in Canada is the cultural mingling it involves . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; When I was growing up in Toronto , you&amp;rsquo ; d have all of these different kinds of stores next to each other or within walking distance . That&amp;rsquo ; s what Canada does so well &amp;hellip ; these amazing ingredients that don&amp;rsquo ; t seem exotic . They seem like they should be used in the food . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; That&amp;rsquo ; s Canadian cuisine . It&amp;rsquo ; s a little bit of everything . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; There is , of course , the danger that Hassan points out , in which a chef&amp;rsquo ; s whims can run roughshod over culinary traditions . Recently , I had another Ottawa chef&amp;rsquo ; s pork belly bao buns . That non-Chinese chef thought it would a good idea to dust his buns with spicy creole seasoning , and put the sweet-savoury hoisin sauce on the side , rather than directly on the pork . He was wrong . The dish was a flop , and furthermore , its pork belly was overcooked. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; But if you consult your food history , the long view of different cuisines suggests they are not as monolithic as they might appear . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Where cultures met , food crossed borders . With the food of Macau , the former Portuguese territory on the south coast of China near Hong Kong , the food of the colonized mixed with dishes of the colonizers . From Latin America to the U.S. South , the food of former slaves has influenced what the descendants of slaveowners eat . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Gumbo in Louisiana dates back 300 years to almost a century before Napoleon sold the territory to the U.S. , but it&amp;rsquo ; s believed to blend the influences and ingredients of French , Spanish , African , Native American and Caribbean cuisines. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; On the other side of the world , in Japan , yoshoku refers to Japanized versions of Western dishes , from spaghetti topped with fish roe and seaweed to various breaded cutlets to the Japanese adaptation of British curries that themselves were adaptations of Indian curries . And lest we think that yoshoku is a recent development , just know that tempura dishes was influenced by the fritter-cooking techniques of the Portuguese residing in Nagasaki in the 16th century . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Of course , the equivalent of yoshoku in North America is the super-sized sushi roll , with eschews the minimalist aesthetic of Japanese sushi in favour of heavy sauces , avocado , mango , cream cheese and more . At the vanguard of this evolution was the California roll , which author Trevor Corson writes in his book The Zen of Fish was invented in the late 1960s at the pioneering Los Angeles eatery Tokyo Kaitan. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; The California roll has come to be seen as a stroke of genius , &amp;rdquo ; Corson writes . &amp;ldquo ; The chef who devised it must have read the American mind , the thinking goes , and adapted sushi to American tastes . &amp;rdquo ; In fact , Corson continues , the California roll was borne out of more practical concerns &amp;mdash ; avocado was substituted after chefs had difficulty obtaining fresh fatty tuna belly . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Regardless of how they came to be , those dishes were fusion dishes . It may have taken generations of evolution , but they have become traditional . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; These days , cultures continue to collide , only much more quickly and haphazardly . While authentic cuisines can be the pillars of the foods we eat and cook , they can&amp;rsquo ; t remain static in the face of global migration and creative cooks . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; As chefs , both haute and homey , tweak the food they grew up with or immerse themselves meaningfully in another culture&amp;rsquo ; s food , dishes can progress and adapt , and new dishes can be born . The results aren&amp;rsquo ; t always for the better , but they aren&amp;rsquo ; t necessarily bad . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; It&amp;rsquo ; s the instances when these new culinary mashups are deep and delicious that make my mouth water . I can vouch that the Viet-Cajun food that has emerged in the recent years in Houston , Texas is not just a thing , it&amp;rsquo ; s a delicious thing . And if you texted me : &amp;ldquo ; Let&amp;rsquo ; s get some turducken siu mai from Gongfu Bao , &amp;rdquo ; I&amp;rsquo ; d be at that Centretown shop in a minute . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; If turducken siu mai or tourti&amp;egrave ; re egg rolls one day came to be authentic Canadian dishes , I would be just fine with that . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;55899;TOOLONG " **32;55926;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; twitter.com/peterhum &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;55960;TOOLONG ... title= " Turducken siu mai at Gongfu Bao. All through high school , I bagged egg rolls , put lids on containers of chicken balls and bagged the lot of them for take-out. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When I worked at the Marco Polo , I grew to love Chinese-Canadian dishes , even though as a young boy , my first reaction to our restaurant&amp;rsquo ; s food was to be disappointed that it wasn&amp;rsquo ; t as tasty as my mother&amp;rsquo ; s &amp;mdash ; authentic &amp;mdash ; home cooking . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Indeed , my connection to Chinese-Canadian food extends to the paternal grandfather I never knew , who operated the Ontario Caf&amp;eacute ; on Rideau Street , where the Rideau Centre is now , during the 1920s and 1930s as far as I can tell . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;h2 class= " cat-head short " **40;56174;TOOLONG ... &lt;ul class= " relatedlinks " &gt; &lt;li&gt;&lt;a href= " https : **33;56216;TOOLONG ... makes food ' authentic , ' and who gets to decide ? &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt; While many details of my family history are still a mystery to me , I&amp;rsquo ; m pleased that one online listing of Ottawa restaurants in the 1930s yields this : &amp;ldquo ; Ontario Caf&amp;eacute ; ( Prop . James W. Hum ) &amp;hellip ; 64-66 Rideau Street . Directory indicates &amp;lsquo ; Chinese . &amp;rsquo ; Brief search indicates name and owner . Restaurant principally appears to have served European/Canadian food , with Chinese dishes as feature . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; You can knock sweet and sour pork and garlic spare ribs as outdated and inauthentic if you want . Canadian writer Ann Hui doesn&amp;rsquo ; t . She came to a fresh understanding after writing her recently released book Chop Suey Nation , which looks back on Chinese-Canadian eateries both in Hui&amp;rsquo ; s family and across the country . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; These are dishes made with local ingredients , made with local palates in mind , made here in Canada that tell this very Canadian story of immigration , &amp;rdquo ; Hui said in an interview with Postmedia News . &amp;ldquo ; To me , it&amp;rsquo ; s as Canadian of a cuisine as anything else &amp;mdash ; as maple syrup , as poutine , as the peameal bacon sandwich . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; This is Canadian&amp;nbsp ; food . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; Peter HumThu , 15 Aug 2019 15:18:07 **45;56251;TOOLONG ... Out : At Grunt in Mechanicsville , seasoned young chef serves fine food , does good deedshttp : **35;56298;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;56335;TOOLONG ... title= " Chef-owner Jason McLelland with some of his dishes at Grunt , his new restaurant in Mechanicsville. Pork and pig-based products figure in the food , but not overwhelmingly so , and a vegetarian could dine happily here . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Portioned somewhere between small plates and main courses , Grunt&amp;rsquo ; s dishes also come with wallet-friendly prices of $15 each , more or less , taxes in . Basically , the prices are in keeping with Grunt&amp;rsquo ; s location , tucked away on a residential side street in the historically blue-collar neighbourhood north of Scott Street and east of Tunney&amp;rsquo ; s Pasture . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Formerly a corner-lot pizzeria , Grunt now seats about 20 at blocky wooden tables and at the counters of its open kitchen where McLelland and his sous-chef toil . Its walls are white , the art is funky and local , the seating is hard , the vintage plates don&amp;rsquo ; t match , and old-time jazz or Billy Idol can take turns on the sound system . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56473;TOOLONG ... title= " Chef-owner Jason McLelland at Grunt , his new restaurant in Mechanicsville. " alt= " Chef-owner Jason McLelland at Grunt , his new restaurant in Mechanicsville. " data-portal-copyright= " Tony Caldwell " **28;56509;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1445199 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; In all , few extravagances distract from Grunt&amp;rsquo ; s pretty , tasty dishes when they quickly land in front of you . &lt;span style= " font-family : -apple-system , BlinkMacSystemFont , ' Segoe UI ' , Roboto , Oxygen-Sans , Ubuntu , Cantarell , ' Helvetica Neue ' , sans-serif ; " &gt;There may not be a more relaxed , human-scale , dining-out experience in Ottawa , especially if McLelland 's wife , Marie , is serving . Once , after she brought us our lunch , she gave her young daughter , Maisie , a ride on her shoulders . &lt;/span&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; McLelland , 31 , most recently worked at the somewhat fancier Town on Elgin Street . Before coming to Ottawa , McLelland worked in fine-dining brigades in London , Paris , Australia and his homeland , Scotland . He even did stints in such Michelin-starred kitchens as Le Gavroche in London , and Le Jules Verne , on the second floor of the Eiffel Tower . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In Mechanicsville , McLelland still makes food for discriminating palates , even if he prioritizes , as he says , &amp;ldquo ; honest and wholesome food&amp;rdquo ; over haute cuisine . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The to-the-point , all-day menu &amp;mdash ; typically a one-page list of three or four savoury dishes and a dessert or two &amp;mdash ; changes every two weeks at Grunt . I spread out my visits accordingly for a longer view of McLelland&amp;rsquo ; s fare . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; If there&amp;rsquo ; s a signature dish at Grunt , it&amp;rsquo ; s McLelland&amp;rsquo ; s porchetta sandwich ( $14.50 ) . The versions that I tried never followed the usual Italian preparation . McLelland preferred to dress up a slab of nicely roasted pork belly like an English Sunday dinner , with Yorkshire pudding , a mushroom demi-glace , crushed root vegetables and apple sauce . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56539;TOOLONG ... title= " Porchetta sandwich , apple sauce , crushed root veg , mushroom demi glace , Yorkshire pudding , at Grunt " alt= " Porchetta sandwich , apple sauce , crushed root veg , mushroom demi glace , Yorkshire pudding , at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56575;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444931 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; It needs an extra napkin , &amp;rdquo ; Marie said when she dropped off a sandwich . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; Oh , that&amp;rsquo ; s promising , &amp;rdquo ; my dining companion said . After polishing off most of it , she said the sandwich justified a return visit to Grunt . That said , the latest menu&amp;rsquo ; s version takes the sandwich in a South Asian direction , swapping in mango chutney and a spicier treatment . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We&amp;rsquo ; ve equally enjoyed other savoury and starchier dishes . Butternut squash risotto ( $16 ) was beautifully balanced and complex , with the indulgences of mascarpone and pancetta and the accents of sage and spiced almonds enlivening the dish&amp;rsquo ; s on-point base of rice and veg . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56605;TOOLONG ... title= " Butternut squash risotto with mascarpone , sage , crispy pancetta , spiced almond crumb at Grunt " alt= " Butternut squash risotto with mascarpone , sage , crispy pancetta , spiced almond crumb at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56641;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1434387 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Grunt&amp;rsquo ; s &amp;ldquo ; gnocchi&amp;rdquo ; made with p&amp;acirc ; te &amp;agrave ; choux ( $15.50 , also known as gnocchi parisienne ) featured tender , pillowy dumplings in a pleasing carbonara sauce , garnished with egg yolk , bacon , goat cheese and green onions . Bread made with bacon fat completed the dish , which despite the richness of its elements left us feeling invigorated rather than weighed down . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56671;TOOLONG ... title= " Pate a choux " gnocchi " with carbonara sauce , sieved egg yolk , bacon , goat 's cheese , bacon fat bread , green onions , shallots , at Grunt " alt= " Pate a choux " gnocchi " with carbonara sauce , sieved egg yolk , bacon , goat 's cheese , bacon fat bread , green onions , shallots , at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56707;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444933 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; A kale Caesar salad topped with a fried egg ( $13.50 ) was a more simple win , zinging with the big flavours of its creamy , anchovy-powered dressing . More novel and bracing was a salad of charred grapefruit and orange with spiced shallots , greens and pumpkin seeds ( $14.50 ) , although the intensity of its bed of turmeric yogurt could have been dialled down . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56737;TOOLONG ... title= " Caesar salad , purple kale , fried egg , crouton , parmesan , pancetta , anchovies at Grunt " alt= " Caesar salad , purple kale , fried egg , crouton , parmesan , pancetta , anchovies at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56773;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444929 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; A plate of bison kofta ( $15 ) was a little muddled visually , and the lean , tasty meat was also a touch dry . Raising the dish up was the focused pop of its sweet semi-dried tomatoes , toasted almonds , crisp onions and shavings of pig fat that McLelland dispensed table-side. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56803;TOOLONG ... title= " Bison Kofta with mint cream , sunblushed tomatoes , toasted almonds , crispy onions , pig fat , at Grunt " alt= " Bison Kofta with mint cream , sunblushed tomatoes , toasted almonds , crispy onions , pig fat , at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56839;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444932 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Desserts at Grunt have been more expensive than many in town , just a little cheaper than the savoury dishes . But don&amp;rsquo ; t let that dissuade you &amp;mdash ; you&amp;rsquo ; ll likely miss out on a treat . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; in June , a strawberry shortcake ( $12.50 ) knocked me out , even if its crumb could have been a bit more tender . Nonetheless , its fruit , cream and sauce were good enough to almost set me cussing in appreciation . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56869;TOOLONG ... title= " Strawberry shortcake at Grunt " alt= " Strawberry shortcake at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56905;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1445188 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; With its table-side splash of fizzing prosecco , lemon sorbet ( $13.50 ) with torched melon , olive oil , lemon balm , zippy pink pepper and some confit lime felt like a celebration . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;56935;TOOLONG ... title= " Lemon sorbet with extra virgin olive oil , confit lime , pink pepper , lemon balm , torched melon , prosecco , at Grunt " alt= " Lemon sorbet with extra virgin olive oil , confit lime , pink pepper , lemon balm , torched melon , prosecco , at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;56971;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1434389 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; While the semifreddo ( $14 ) that came with roasted strawberries , raspberry coulis and cracked black pepper had set too hard , this was one more dish whose strong points and thoughtfulness made its lapse forgivable. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57001;TOOLONG ... title= " Roasted strawberry and raspberry coulis , cracked black pepper , semifreddo at Grunt " alt= " Roasted strawberry and raspberry coulis , cracked black pepper , semifreddo at Grunt " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57037;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1444930 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Grunt is licensed , with a dozen wines mostly from the Old World priced between $40 and $65 a bottle , with five-ounce glasses also available . Beers by Beau&amp;rsquo ; s Brewing Co. , its offshoot Halcyon Barrel House and Stalwart Brewing Co. are available , as is coffee from a fine espresso machine that shares counter space with a miniature garden of micro-greens and a trusty immersion circulator. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; If Grunt wasn&amp;rsquo ; t special enough already , it is also becoming a booster for Mechanicsville , which McLelland calls &amp;ldquo ; beautiful&amp;rdquo ; but also &amp;ldquo ; rough around the edges , &amp;rdquo ; not unlike the part of Scotland where he grew up . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; After a fire down the street left a family homeless last month , Grunt gave over its walls to paintings by Andrea Stokes , all of which were sold to raise money to help the family . In June , Grunt hosted a 90th birthday party for Keith Brown , the life-long neighbourhood resident and volunteer who has been dubbed &amp;ldquo ; the Mayor of Mechanicsville. &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; McLelland has begun giving free monthly cooking classes . He says if there are families who can&amp;rsquo ; t afford a night out at a restaurant , he&amp;rsquo ; s not opposed to feeding them for free if they make reservations . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; McLelland , who lives in Gloucester with his in-laws , says he was happy to open Grunt in Mechanicsville . Elgin Street and Wellington Street West have enough restaurants , he says . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; I could use this as a platform to do some good , &amp;rdquo ; McLelland says of his business . That&amp;rsquo ; s what he&amp;rsquo ; s doing , and deliciously so . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;57067;TOOLONG " **32;57094;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; &lt;a href= " http : //twitter.com/peterhum " &gt;twitter ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;57128;TOOLONG ... Food ReviewsDining Out : Nikosi Bistro Pub a distinctive , uncomplicated eatery in Wakefieldhttp : **31;57315;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;57348;TOOLONG ... title= " Wild boar burger with salad and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Wild boar burger with salad and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57384;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1443633 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Nikosi Bistro Pub&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 721 Riverside Dr. , Wakefield , 819-459-3773 , &lt;a href= " http : //nikosibistropub.com " &gt;nikosibi ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Wednesday 4 to 9 p.m. , Thursday 4 to 10 p.m. , Friday and Saturday 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. , Sunday 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. , closed Monday and Tuesday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; main courses $19 to $45 &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; ramp to front door &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; A week ago , we got a jump on the long weekend by spending Friday afternoon in Wakefield . Some time kayaking on the Gatineau River would do us good , my wife and I thought . But first , we had lunch at Nikosi Bistro Pub . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In early 2017 , this casual spot was opened by Wapokunie Riel-Lachapelle , who grew up in Wakefield . She went out west and worked in restaurants for a time , but eventually returned and launched Nikosi , where the fare is simple and from-scratch . Fish and game meat frequently star on Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s plates , and Riel-Lachapelle told me when we chatted on the phone this year that she makes a connection between the food she serves and her M&amp;eacute ; t is heritage . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We ate on Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s river-facing patio , shielded from the blazing sun by big umbrellas . My wife and I enjoyed our starter of smoked salmon ( $18 ) , served on thin wedges of house-made bannock bread . The fish was luscious and maple-tinged , while fried capers added a salty pop and the side salad was fresh . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57414;TOOLONG ... title= " Smoked salmon on bannock appetizer at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Smoked salmon on bannock appetizer at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57450;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1442260 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Two generously portioned mains followed . My boar burger ( $20 ) was heftily meaty and fully loaded with caramelized onions , maple-sweetened mushrooms , bacon , aged cheddar and maple-garlic aioli . With some fine fries and a heap of salad , my order amounted to lunch and then some . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57480;TOOLONG ... title= " Wild boar burger with salad and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Wild boar burger with salad and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57516;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1443633 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; My wife , who can never get too much salmon , thought her barbecued salmon ( $24 ) , which came with the same fries and salad that I received , was just a touch too dry , but nicely flavoured . She too had leftovers , and we combined everything into a container that Riel-Lachapelle graciously kept in Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s fridge until we came back after kayaking. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57546;TOOLONG ... title= " Barbecue salmon at Nikosi Bistro Pub " alt= " Barbecue salmon at Nikosi Bistro Pub " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57582;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1443639 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; At another lunch earlier this summer , a friend and I spent some time perusing Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s cocktail menu . The $10 options intrigued us , from the black currant margarita to a smokey Caesar to the &amp;ldquo ; &amp;eacute ; lectrique powwow&amp;rdquo ; made with Chic-Choc spiced rum from Quebec&amp;rsquo ; s Eastern Townships , ginger ale , lime juice , berries and mint . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; At Nikosi , the negroni is Canadian-ized with a bit of spruce reduction . I don&amp;rsquo ; t if Anthony Bourdain would have approved of this tweak of his favourite , potent , Italian cocktail , but I did . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; After that drink came a mound of elk tartare ( $17 ) , which was lean , quite mild of flavour and enhanced with pickled mushrooms and parmesan . While its seasoning could have been more bold , the tartare nonetheless disappeared quickly as we scooped the stuff up with bannock crostini. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57612;TOOLONG ... title= " Elk tartare at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Elk tartare at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57648;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1442251 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The two main courses at that lunch were pleasant enough , but needed a bit more finesse to sparkle as they might have . Chunks of duck breast ( $27 ) had an admirably crisp exterior , but were otherwise overcooked . Wilted kale , pickled blueberries and crisp potatoes made up somewhat for that flaw . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57678;TOOLONG ... title= " Duck breast with kale and potatoes at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Duck breast with kale and potatoes at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57714;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1442261 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Pickerel , the day&amp;rsquo ; s fish special ( $24 ) , was fried straightforwardly , but let down by the mix of wild rice and veg on the side , which did very little for me. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57744;TOOLONG ... title= " Pickerel with beets and wild rice at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Pickerel with beets and wild rice at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57780;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1442250 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Last winter , I also ate twice inside Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s rustic , woody dining room that seats about 40 . Then , some of the cooking was uneven . There was a flank steak ( $27 ) that was fine , but the fries with them were the opposite of crisp . Confit duck wings with house-made barbecue sauce ( $17 ) , which remain on the summer menu , were under-seasoned and flaccid-skinned. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57810;TOOLONG ... title= " Flank steak and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Flank steak and fries at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57846;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1361171 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57876;TOOLONG ... title= " Duck wings at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " alt= " Duck wings at Nikosi Bistro Pub in Wakefield " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57912;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1361172 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Better was Nikosi&amp;rsquo ; s grilled cheese ( $19 ) , a still-available deluxe bannock-based sandwich made with some of the kitchen&amp;rsquo ; s go-to ingredients ( caramelized onions , maple-sweetened mushrooms , aged cheddar , spinach , maple-garlic aioli ) along with chunks of duck sausage . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;57942;TOOLONG ... title= " Bannock grilled cheese with duck sausage , maple mushrooms , cheddar , spinach " alt= " Bannock grilled cheese with duck sausage , maple mushrooms , cheddar , spinach " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;57978;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1361175 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Duck sausage , spinach , caramelized onions and maple-sweetened mushrooms also turned in last winter&amp;rsquo ; s rib-sticking mac and cheese , which was topped with a rich mornay sauce ( $20 ) . I look forward to having this dish again when the weather turns cold . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58008;TOOLONG ... title= " Nikosi mac and cheese with duck sausage , Mornay sauce , caramelized onions , maple mushrooms , spinach and bannock breadcrumbs " alt= " Nikosi mac and cheese with duck sausage , Mornay sauce , caramelized onions , maple mushrooms , spinach and bannock breadcrumbs " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58044;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1361174 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; ve only had one dessert at Nikosi &amp;mdash ; a slice of salted caramel cheesecake that did the trick even if it wasn&amp;rsquo ; t made in house . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When I spoke to Riel-Lachapelle , she told me that while she had a hand in developing the recipes at Nikosi , she is more of a do-everything general manager who has left the kitchen in other hands . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Her father , a keen hunter and fisherman , was a good cook , she continued . &amp;ldquo ; I didn&amp;rsquo ; t realized back then how lucky I was , &amp;rdquo ; Riel-Lachapelle said . &amp;ldquo ; Growing up &amp;hellip ; that impacted my life and my appreciation of food . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Nikosi Bistro Pub , then , is an uncomplicated but distinctive eatery of which its owner and her father can be proud . &lt;/p&gt; " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58355;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1430908 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Tamis Caf ? &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt; 374 Bank St. , 613-567-7550 , &lt;a href= " http : //tamiscafe.ca " &gt;tamiscafe.ca&lt; ... or &lt;a href= " http : **27;58385;TOOLONG " &gt;fa ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Tuesday to Thursday 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. , Friday and Saturday 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. , Sunday 9:30 a.m. to 3 p.m. , closed Monday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; brunch dishes up to $15 , mains up to $17 &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; one step to front door &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Three years ago , I learned that the word for &amp;ldquo ; sweet&amp;rdquo ; in Tagalog , the national language of the Philippines , was &amp;ldquo ; tamis. &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I owed my education to several enjoyable visits to the Tamis Caf&amp;eacute ; , a tiny place in the Glebe that opened in early 2016 and featured unique Filipino baked goods in its showcase. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; That eatery , operated by the Sare family , was tucked away on Fourth Avenue east of Bank Street . It moved late last year to Centretown , into the Bank Street space that had been The Buzz for more than 15 years . With the move has come an expanded menu with more savoury choices , and also a liquor licence that supports the array of Filipino San Miguel beers that serve as the backdrop for Tamis&amp;rsquo ; s bar , as well as some exotic cocktails and a more ordinary and perfunctory wine list . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; So , I&amp;rsquo ; ve tried the new Tamis Caf&amp;eacute ; &amp;mdash ; a long , narrow , brick-walled spot that seats 40 or so in black banquettes and seats &amp;mdash ; a few times this summer to sample some of its savoury moves and investigate Filipino cuisine , which in Ottawa is in short supply . ( I know only of Ka Familia in Barrhaven , the Meryenda food truck , plus a handful of grocery stores and bakery that dedicate themselves to the intriguing east-meets-west fare of the Philippines. ) &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; New to me at the relocated , larger Tamis was its brunch menu , which is available daily and melds Western staples with Filipino items . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The most visually striking plate at brunch paired hefty buttermilk pancakes ( $12 ) &amp;mdash ; coloured a Seussian bright green by a syrup flavoured by pandan , the Southeast Asian plant &amp;mdash ; with thick , stubby , skinless longanisa sausages , which appealed with their porky goodness perked by garlic and pineapple . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58414;TOOLONG ... title= " Pandan pancakes and loganisa sausage at Tamis Caf ? " alt= " Pandan pancakes and loganisa sausage at Tamis Caf ? " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58450;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1430916 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Those delectable sausages also showed up with home fries or garlicky rice , both equally good , plus eggs , cooked as we liked , and toast ( $15 ) . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; We were also able to order from the regular menu during that brunch visit . That meant we could sample Tamis&amp;rsquo ; s embutido ( $13 ) , a cold pork meatloaf that was mellow in flavour and slightly crumbly , served with a simple , cucumber-heavy salad , and lumpia ( $13 ) , a thin , soft , freshly made , neutral-tasting crepe stuffed with saut&amp;eacute ; ed green beans , carrots , sweet potatoes , potatoes , lettuce , and served with peanut sauce . Both items were humble and homey. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58480;TOOLONG ... title= " Embutido meatloaf and salad at Tamis Caf ? " alt= " Embutido meatloaf and salad at Tamis Caf ? " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58516;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1432749 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; During two dinner visits , my friends and I tried four of Tamis&amp;rsquo ; s appetizers. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Most accessible was a heaping platter ( $20 ) of deep-fried spring rolls , wontons and chips , all served with a sweet and sour sauce that we thought needed more punchiness. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58546;TOOLONG ... title= " Appetizer platter at Tamis Cafe " alt= " Appetizer platter at Tamis Cafe " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58582;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1434165 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; More daunting , and more oily , was the fried whole squid ( $20 ) , which was tender enough of tentacle but not as crisp as we might have liked . Overall , the squid amounted to a heavy offering that we could not polish off . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58612;TOOLONG ... title= " Fried whole calamari at Tamis Caf ? " alt= " Fried whole calamari at Tamis Caf ? " data-portal-copyright= " Postmedia " **28;58648;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1432562 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; We did finish off our sizzling sisig ( $16 ) , a dish in which bits of grilled and saut&amp;eacute ; ed pork belly mingled with pigs ears and a smattering of chilli peppers and red onions . While I recall having some meatier sisig during a trip to the Cayman Islands this year , the chewiness and fattiness of this dish dominated this time out . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58678;TOOLONG ... title= " Sizzling sisig ( pork belly and pig ears ) at Tamis Caf ? " alt= " Sizzling sisig ( pork belly and pig ears ) at Tamis Caf ? " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58714;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1432559 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The dish is designated as mild on Tamis&amp;rsquo ; s menu , which I take as a reference to the amount of chilli peppers at play . I would have welcomed more heat on this and other dishes , but in general , Tamis&amp;rsquo ; s kitchen skews to the milder side of things , even as it proffers the sour , sweet and salty aspects of Filipino cuisine . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Another revelation at Tamis Caf&amp;eacute ; was that cheese pimento dip is beloved by many Filipinos . A hunk of the dense , house-made stuff is available as an appetizer , and a mound of it figured as the crowning garnish on the caf&amp;eacute ; &amp;rsquo ; s plump longanisa burger . My friend ( who is not Filipino , it should perhaps be said ) liked everything about that juicy burger except the cheese dip , which he found overpowering . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58744;TOOLONG ... title= " Pimento cheese appetizer at Tamis Caf ? " alt= " Pimento cheese appetizer at Tamis Caf ? " data-portal-copyright= " " **28;58780;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1430910 " /&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;58810;TOOLONG ... title= " Longanisa burger with chips at Tamis Caf ? Food ReviewsDining Out : Farinella serves up pizza and gelato satisfactionhttp : **28;59921;TOOLONG ... &lt;img src= " https : **34;59951;TOOLONG ... title= " Cesare Agostini co-owner and pizza specialist at Farinella on Rochester Street , a one-stop spot for pizza and gelato. " alt= " Cesare Agostini co-owner and pizza specialist at Farinella on Rochester Street , a one-stop spot for pizza and gelato. " data-portal-copyright= " Ashley Fraser " **28;59987;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429559 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; **38;60017;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; 492 Rochester St. , 613-422-6462 , &lt;a href= " http : //farinellaeats.com " &gt;farinellae ... &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Open : &lt;/strong&gt; Tuesday to Thursday 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. , Friday and Saturday 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. , Sunday 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. , closed Monday &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Prices : &lt;/strong&gt; pizza slices cut to order and sold by weight , between $2.99 and $3.60 per 100 grams &lt;br&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Access : &lt;/strong&gt; no steps to front door or washrooms &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Last week , a colleague of mine was in desperate need of a pizza pick-me-up. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The day before we went for lunch , she had what she said was the worst pizza of her life . Ordered from a west-end chain , its crust was tough , but also droopy in spots . The pizza was short on cheese , but also greasy from its meaty components . In short , those slices had no redeeming qualities . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I wanted to restore her faith in pizza by taking her to a pizza purveyor whose standards had not slipped so egregiously . Off we went , then , to Farinella. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Opened in mid-May in a former scooter shop on Rochester Street , this casual eatery in Little Italy has been doing brisk business thanks to impeccably made pizza and a novel-in-Ottawa business model that strives for speedy gratification . And if that weren&amp;rsquo ; t enough , Farinella also turns out some strikingly fresh and varied gelato. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;60057;TOOLONG ... title= " Siblings Cesare and Nina Agostini co-own Farinella on Rochester Street , a one stop spot for pizza and gelato . Cesare works on one of his pizzas . " alt= " Siblings Cesare and Nina Agostini co-own Farinella on Rochester Street , a one stop spot for pizza and gelato . Cesare works on one of his pizzas . " data-portal-copyright= " Ashley Fraser " **28;60093;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429789 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Before our visit , I&amp;rsquo ; d eaten twice already at Farinella , joining the inevitable peak-hour lineups that fortunately are fast-moving . I&amp;rsquo ; ve savoured enough examples of meaty , cheesy and vegetable-forward goodness to feel that Farinella is basically a sure thing for deep and resolutely traditional pizza satisfaction . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; It didn&amp;rsquo ; t take long to figure out the ordering routine here , which is common in Italy yet new to Ottawa . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When the queue brings you to one of Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s counterpersons , you ask for descriptions of the day&amp;rsquo ; s four kinds of pizzas &amp;mdash ; meaty , cheesy , veggie or plain &amp;mdash ; that are ready for consumption . The pizzas on display in front of you are Roman-style creations , with bread-y bases that are oblongs almost one-metre long and toppings that Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s co-owner Cesare Agostini , an Ottawa-raised 27-year-old who spent four years making pizza in Rome to gain his expertise , says are &amp;ldquo ; strictly traditional . &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Then you ask for as much as you want of however many pizzas . The staffer cuts that much pizza off the oblong , and your order is weighed and priced , with the most expensive , meaty pizzas going for $3.60 for 100 grams . You pay and then either head home with your box filled with assorted pizza , or take your tray to one of the counters indoors or a no-frills table outside Farinella , which if the place were fancier would be equipped with sun umbrellas . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; When my co-worker bit into a slab of pizza topped with shaved asparagus and mozzarella , it washed away her pizza funk. &amp;ldquo ; Mmmm , &amp;rdquo ; she said . &amp;ldquo ; Where have you been all my life , asparagus pizza ? &amp;rdquo ; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; I&amp;rsquo ; ve asked myself similar questions upon sampling Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s potato pizza , flecked with rosemary and notably peppery , some mushroom pizza that tucked its fungus under dollops of gloriously molten whipped ricotta , pizza that played vibrant fresh tomatoes against their sun-dried cousins and some utterly simple zucchini pizza about which I wouldn&amp;rsquo ; t change a thing . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;60123;TOOLONG ... title= " Assorted pizza ( including rosso , potato , zucchini and salami and olive ) at Farinella " alt= " Assorted pizza ( including rosso , potato , zucchini and salami and olive ) at Farinella " data-portal-copyright= " Peter Hum " **28;60159;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429742 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; All of those pizzas did just fine without tomato sauce . If the red stuff is your thing , it stars in Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s&amp;nbsp ; basic but satisfying &amp;ldquo ; rossi&amp;rdquo ; pizza . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The choices for carnivores have all hit the spot , including pizzas featuring artichoke and nduja , the spicy and spreadable Italian pork product , or mellow prosciutto cotto blanketed with cheese , or the lucid punch of salami and olives . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; In all , every variety of Farinella pizza that I&amp;rsquo ; ve tried has put a smile on my face with forthright combinations of shining ingredients that play well with one another . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; While the toppings might vary with every visit , the key constant for me is how good the sturdy crust has been . Agostini told me his pizzas are baked first for up to eight minutes at up to 600F before they are topped and then baked for a few more minutes . The results are crusts that can be deliciously crisp but with a tender crumb , somewhere between pillowy focaccia and a shatteringly hard cracker . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;60189;TOOLONG ... title= " Siblings Cesare and Nina Agostini co-own Farinella on Rochester Street , a one-stop spot for pizza and gelato. " alt= " Siblings Cesare and Nina Agostini co-own Farinella on Rochester Street , a one-stop spot for pizza and gelato. " data-portal-copyright= " Ashley Fraser " **28;60225;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429785 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Meanwhile , Cesare&amp;rsquo ; s 24-year-old sister and business partner Nina made her own extended trip to Italy , but specialized for four years in making ice cream rather than pizza . While Cesare plied his craft at the bakery Antico Forno Roscioli in Rome , Nina , soon after graduating from high school in Ottawa , went to Italy to study gelato making , eventually becoming the head gelato maker and general manager at Menchetti in Perugia. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; You can taste Nina&amp;rsquo ; s gelato-making cred in the super-fresh ice cream found in Farinella&amp;rsquo ; s showcase . As much as I gravitate to dark chocolate gelato at most opportunities , I&amp;rsquo ; m most likely to order vibrant flavours such as Rhone Valley apricot , Sicilian lemon , Indonesian coconut or sumptuous fior de latte when I next visit . That is , if I don&amp;rsquo ; t order an affogato &amp;mdash ; a cup of vanilla gelato with a shot with excellent , potent espresso on the side . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;img src= " https : **34;60255;TOOLONG ... title= " Nina Agostini serves some gelato at Farinella on Rochester Street , which she co-owns with her brother Cesare . " alt= " Nina Agostini serves some gelato at Farinella on Rochester Street , which she co-owns with her brother Cesare . " data-portal-copyright= " Ashley Fraser " **28;60291;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1429561 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; The restaurant is licensed but does not yet serve alcohol . While customers now bake outside in the summer heat , a winterized patio is a possibility , Cesare says . Cold weather may see ice pops , cakes and &amp;ldquo ; prettier , daintier things&amp;rdquo ; added as dessert options , Nina says . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; As easy as it is to romanticize living and working in Italy , the Agostinis say that returning to Ottawa , where food-business work was in their blood , always beckoned. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &amp;ldquo ; We did not have a glamorous life in Italy , &amp;rdquo ; Nina says . &amp;ldquo ; It was terrible . I hated it , &amp;rdquo ; Cesare adds . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; It&amp;rsquo ; s a good thing for Ottawa eaters that the siblings had it hard in Italy and that they returned to their hometown , where they now employ 30 and crank out as many as 150 pizzas in a day . Italy&amp;rsquo ; s loss is Ottawa&amp;rsquo ; s distinct culinary gain , and from now on , it will be hard for me to settle for lesser pizza here . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " **25;60321;TOOLONG " **32;60348;TOOLONG &lt;br&gt; &lt;a href= " http : //twitter.com/peterhum " &gt;twitter ... &lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;strong&gt;ALSO IN THE NEWS : &lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " https : **33;60382;TOOLONG ... to grow a music festival : Kemptville fest thrives on boomers&lt;/a&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;a href= " http : **34;60417;TOOLONG ... " alt= " Chefs prepare food as ten different chefs compete in Canada 's Great Kitchen Party with their unique dishes at the Shaw Centre . " data-portal-copyright= " Wayne Cuddington " **28;60609;TOOLONG " 1 " data-license-id= " 1425823 " /&gt; &lt;p&gt; Eight Ottawa-area chefs will put their best plates forward in November at the Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Great Kitchen Party Ottawa event , hoping to win a berth at next winter&amp;rsquo ; s 2020 Canadian Culinary Championships at the Shaw Centre . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The chefs invited to compete are : Shane Brown of Beckta Dining and Wine Bar ; Ian Carswell of the Black Tartan Kitchen in Carleton Place ; Justin Champagne of Bar Lupulus ; Billy Khoo of fauna food + bar ; Ben Landreville of Sidedoor ; Daniela Manrique of Soca Kitchen ; Razmon Poisson of Orto Trattoria ; and Jason Sawision of Stofa Restaurant . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; At last fall&amp;rsquo ; s event , once the judges had deliberated , Manrique came in second while Sawision finished third . The winner that night , chef Yannick LaSalle of Restaurant Les Foug&amp;egrave ; res in Chelsea , went on to win this year&amp;rsquo ; s Canadian Culinary Championships in Kelowna , B.C. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; The competing chefs will square off Nov. 19 at Le Cordon Bleu Ottawa . This qualifier for the national competition will be &amp;ldquo ; a more intimate , boutique-style event&amp;rdquo ; compared to the 2018 Canada&amp;rsquo ; s Great Kitchen Party at the Shaw Centre and its precursor , the Gold Medal Plates competition , a press release stated . &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; Tickets for the Nov. 19 event will initially be available bundled with tickets for the national championships , to be held Jan. 31 and Feb. 1 .
